q: 一共有多少条岗位数据？
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM jobs

q: 通过筛选的岗位有多少条？
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM jobs WHERE reject_reason = ''

q: AI 应用方向的岗位，月薪上限最高是多少 K？
gold: SELECT MAX(salary_max_k) AS max_k FROM jobs WHERE keyword = 'AI应用'

q: 全部岗位按 keyword 分组，每个方向各有多少条？
gold: SELECT keyword, COUNT(*) AS n FROM jobs GROUP BY keyword ORDER BY n DESC

q: 哪个区的岗位数量最多（不算没写区的）？
gold: SELECT district, COUNT(*) AS n FROM jobs WHERE district <> '' GROUP BY district ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

q: 南山区和福田区各有多少个岗位？
gold: SELECT district, COUNT(*) AS n FROM jobs WHERE district IN ('南山区','福田区') GROUP BY district ORDER BY district

q: 月薪上限超过 30K 的岗位有哪些？只要岗位名和公司两列
gold: SELECT title, company FROM jobs WHERE salary_kind = 'monthly' AND salary_max_k > 30 ORDER BY salary_max_k DESC

q: 所有月薪岗位的平均月薪下限是多少 K？
gold: SELECT ROUND(AVG(salary_min_k), 2) AS avg_min_k FROM jobs WHERE salary_kind = 'monthly'

q: 按薪资下限从高到低排序，列出前 5 条的岗位名、公司、薪资下限 K 值
gold: SELECT title, company, salary_min_k FROM jobs WHERE salary_kind = 'monthly' ORDER BY salary_min_k DESC LIMIT 5

q: 要求 3-5 年经验的岗位有多少条？
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM jobs WHERE experience = '3-5年'

q: 要求本科的岗位占比是多少？
gold: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN degree = '本科' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct FROM jobs

q: 被筛掉的岗位里，因为薪资低于 15K 的有多少条？
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM jobs WHERE reject_reason = '薪资低于 15K'

q: 杭州有多少个岗位？
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM jobs WHERE city = '杭州'

q: 标题里带『实习』的岗位名，列举前 5 条
gold: SELECT title FROM jobs WHERE title LIKE '%实习%' LIMIT 5

q: 五险一金这个标签出现在多少个岗位里？
gold: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT job_id) AS n FROM job_tags WHERE tag = '五险一金'

q: 同时带 Java 和 本科 标签的岗位有多少条？
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT job_id FROM job_tags WHERE tag = 'Java' INTERSECT SELECT job_id FROM job_tags WHERE tag = '本科')

q: 每个关键词下，通过筛选的月薪岗位平均薪资下限是多少 K？
gold: SELECT keyword, ROUND(AVG(salary_min_k), 2) AS avg_min_k FROM jobs WHERE reject_reason = '' AND salary_kind = 'monthly' GROUP BY keyword ORDER BY avg_min_k DESC

q: 月薪上限最高的那条岗位是哪个公司？只输出公司名一列
gold: SELECT company FROM jobs WHERE salary_kind = 'monthly' ORDER BY salary_max_k DESC LIMIT 1

q: 日薪岗位有多少条？平均日薪上限是多少元？
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(AVG(daily_max_yuan), 0) AS avg_daily FROM jobs WHERE salary_kind = 'daily'

q: 数据分析方向一共有多少条岗位，其中通过筛选的有几条？
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN reject_reason = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passed FROM jobs WHERE keyword = '数据分析'

q: 列出岗位数量最少的 3 个区（不含空值）
gold: SELECT district, COUNT(*) AS n FROM jobs WHERE district <> '' GROUP BY district ORDER BY n ASC, district LIMIT 3

q: 年薪（月薪上限乘 12）最高的岗位是哪个？只输出岗位名和公司两列
gold: SELECT title, company FROM jobs WHERE salary_kind = 'monthly' ORDER BY salary_max_k DESC LIMIT 1

q: 大模型方向通过筛选的岗位有哪些？给出岗位名和公司名
gold: SELECT title, company FROM jobs WHERE keyword = '大模型' AND reject_reason = ''

q: 既没有写区、薪资字段也是空的岗位有多少条？
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM jobs WHERE district = '' AND salary_raw = ''

q: 13 薪以上的岗位有多少条？
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM jobs WHERE salary_months >= 13

q: 各学历要求下，月薪岗位的平均薪资上限是多少 K？
gold: SELECT degree, ROUND(AVG(salary_max_k), 2) AS avg_max_k FROM jobs WHERE salary_kind = 'monthly' AND degree <> '' GROUP BY degree ORDER BY avg_max_k DESC

q: 测试开发方向在南山区的岗位有几条？
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM jobs WHERE keyword = '测试开发' AND district = '南山区'

q: 月薪岗位的平均薪资区间（下限到上限）是多少 K？
gold: SELECT ROUND(AVG(salary_min_k), 2) AS avg_min_k, ROUND(AVG(salary_max_k), 2) AS avg_max_k FROM jobs WHERE salary_kind = 'monthly'

q: 哪些公司招的岗位数量最多？列出前 5 家
gold: SELECT company, COUNT(*) AS n FROM jobs GROUP BY company ORDER BY n DESC, company LIMIT 5

q: 经验不限的月薪岗位，平均薪资下限是多少 K？
gold: SELECT ROUND(AVG(salary_min_k), 2) AS avg_min_k FROM jobs WHERE experience = '经验不限' AND salary_kind = 'monthly'
